mentions.name: Open-source inventory management system
mentions.description: This is an open-source inventory management system designed to handle multiple stores, each with their own inventory and products. Products are organized into categories and sub-categories, with location management for each item. Development is ongoing and the system still needs more work.
mentions.problem: The builder couldn't find an open-source inventory management system they liked.
mentions.audience: It was meant to serve as the base of a few online stores and a brick-and-mortar shop, but that business plan fell through.
mentions.source_excerpt: I couldn't find an open-source inventory management system I liked, so I started working on one.  It was designed to handle multiple stores, each with their own inventory and products.  Each product in categories and sub-categories, and location management for each item.
mentions.author: psion
